## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Heart-Essentials of Chán Master Fóguǒ Kèqín* — a four-juan collection of letters and doctrinal-essays by [Yuánwù Kèqín](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%8B%E5%8B%A4) 圓悟克勤 (*shì* Fóguǒ 佛果, 1063–1135), the compiler of the famous *Bì yán lù* and one of the major Northern-Sòng Línjì-Yángqí masters. Compiled by his dharma-heir [Zǐwén](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%90%E6%96%87) 子文.

Four-juan Northern-Sòng Chán doctrinal collection, X69 n1357. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

The *xīn yào* 心要 ("heart-essentials") format emphasises the most important teaching-content of the master — typically his letters to disciples containing concise doctrinal instruction, a form Kèqín was particularly prolific in.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1115; *notAfter* 1135 (Kèqín's death).
